title: Sound effect/envelope: wire Effect dropdown to model and emit SoundEnvelope in StartSound SWF tag
description:
The Sound panel (packages/authoring-ui/src/SoundPanel.tsx) shows an Effect dropdown with options: None, Left Channel, Right Channel, Fade Left to Right, Fade Right to Left, Fade In, Fade Out. However:
1. SoundLinkage (packages/core/src/model/types.ts) has no 'effect' field — the dropdown value is never saved to the document model.
2. The SWF compile path (packages/swf/src/audio.ts encodeStartSound) never emits SoundEnvelope records in the StartSound tag, so audio effects don't reach Ruffle.
3. The 'Edit envelope' button in SoundPanel is explicitly stubbed with title 'Edit envelope (not yet implemented)'.

Scope (minimal — skip the envelope dialog, just wire the preset effects):
1. Add effect?: 'none' | 'leftChannel' | 'rightChannel' | 'fadeLeftToRight' | 'fadeRightToLeft' | 'fadeIn' | 'fadeOut' to SoundLinkage in packages/core/src/model/types.ts.
2. Wire the SoundPanel Effect dropdown to save effect onto SoundLinkage via onSoundChange.
3. In encodeStartSound (packages/swf/src/audio.ts), translate each preset effect to standard Flash SoundEnvelope point pairs:
   - leftChannel: L=32767 R=0 from frame 0
   - rightChannel: L=0 R=32767 from frame 0
   - fadeLeftToRight: L=32767->0, R=0->32767 over full duration
   - fadeRightToLeft: L=0->32767, R=32767->0 over full duration
   - fadeIn: L=0->32767, R=0->32767 (2 envelope points)
   - fadeOut: L=32767->0, R=32767->0 (2 envelope points)
4. Emit hasEnvelope=1 and the envelope records in the StartSound flags/body.

The Edit Envelope dialog (custom volume curve per channel) is out of scope for this task — that requires a waveform canvas UI and is a separate feature.

Acceptance: publish a SWF with a Fade In sound on a keyframe; in Ruffle the sound volume rises from silence. Verify via manual Test Movie.
